description: Full-episode actor-dose sweep at fixed J6/N512/H3/B512, C6 or C12, and T3. Actor updates increase from the earlier A3 control to A6 or A12, using the same overlapping total-budget schedule and checkpoint-derived model/environment.

actor_budget.description: A6 and A12 for both earlier C6/C12 bootstrap settings. Reuse the five completed prior episode bundles; no bank solves or A3 reruns are required. Temperature remains adaptive with three updates per round.

inner_target_c6_a6.description: J6/N512/H3/B512, inner_target bootstraps, C6/A6/T3 per round (36/36/18 per decision). Components run in their first allocated slots: critic then actor then temperature within each shared slot. Only actor dose differs from the earlier C6/A3/T3 setting.

inner_target_c12_a6.description: J6/N512/H3/B512, inner_target bootstraps, C12/A6/T3 per round (72/36/18 per decision). Components run in their first allocated slots: critic then actor then temperature within each shared slot. Only actor dose differs from the earlier C12/A3/T3 setting.

outer_target_c6_a6.description: J6/N512/H3/B512, outer_target bootstraps, C6/A6/T3 per round (36/36/18 per decision). Components run in their first allocated slots: critic then actor then temperature within each shared slot. Only actor dose differs from the earlier C6/A3/T3 setting.
